title: A Justice Lens on Fairness and Ethics Courses in Computing Education: LLM-Assisted Multi-Perspective and Thematic Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI/ML course syllabi using a justice-oriented rubric and LLM-driven thematic analysis to assess authorship diversity, the inclusion of historically marginalized perspectives, and the presence of decolonial approaches.
Scoring course syllabi based on their inclusion and depth of teaching topics related to potential algorithmic harms, demographic disparities, and bias mitigation techniques.

Simulating multiple distinct evaluator personas (Instructor, Department Chair, Internal Evaluator, External Evaluator) via LLM prompting to measure how differing institutional roles and implicit biases influence the assessment of justice-related course criteria.
